run_mode: native venv, served (openai endpoint + `vllm bench serve`)
gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 (sm_120 / cc 12.0), 32607 MiB, single GPU
cuda_graphs: ON (not --enforce-eager); 'Graph capturing finished ... took 0.55-0.57 GiB' in every run
sanity: per-config chat gate: 'What is the capital of France?' -> 'The capital of France is Paris.' (coherent in all three configs)
schema: each config.results row = {input_len, ttft_ms, prefill_tok_s, tpot_ms, itl_ms, decode_tok_s}
notes: REQUIRED WORKAROUND on sm_120: VLLM_USE_FLASHINFER_SAMPLER=0. Without it every config dies at sampler warmup with RuntimeError('FlashInfer requires GPUs with sm75 or higher') on an sm_120 card. Root cause: flashinfer's _normalize_cuda_arch() needs nvcc >= 12.9 to emit compute_120f, the host has CUDA 12.8, so it raises 'SM 12.x requires CUDA >= 12.9', which the caller swallows in a bare except, leaving TARGET_CUDA_ARCHS empty -> the sm75 check then fails. Attention backend is unaffected; only the sampler JIT path.
PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True set for fp8/fp8kv and the published bf16 run.
gpu-memory-utilization differs per config (bf16 0.92, fp8/fp8kv 0.90) because bf16 has no stable point at 0.95 (OOM at 16k) or 0.88 (erratic). Documented per config.
Different sweeps used different gpu_util, so compare TPOT across configs at equal ctx with that caveat in mind; the fp8 vs bf16 gap (-33%) is far larger than the bf16 0.92-vs-0.95 spread (<1%).

configs.sanity_generated: The capital of France is Paris.
notes: OOM at gpu-memory-utilization 0.95 for ctx=16384 (weights 22.68 GiB + KV 5.84 GiB left no room for the 8192-token chunked-prefill activations). Verbatim: 'CUDA out of memory. Tried to allocate 480.00 MiB. GPU 0 has a total capacity of 31.36 GiB of which 20.00 MiB is free.'
gpu-memory-utilization 0.88 runs without OOM but is ERRATIC/non-monotonic (4k 31.45, 8k 18.86, 16k 28.71 ms) - too small a KV pool. Not used for the published column.
0.92 is the stable operating point: monotonic, and its 4k/8k reproduce the 0.95 run (18.12/18.77) within 0.7%.
ctx=32768 NOT reachable in bf16: KV pool is 27,182 tokens < the 32,896 required.
